EV-04.name: Conflicting data - free-time clock running on an undischarged unit

raw.text:
WAREHOUSE SUMMARY: WH-BCN, 84% occupancy (at-risk band), 1 container reviewed, 0 at risk, 1 escalated, 0 EUR total exposure at stake

---

CONTAINER: P-2055
CARRIER: Poseidón Freight
CONTAINER TYPE: 40DRY
DAYS LEFT: UNKNOWN
COUNTS: NONE APPLY
OPTIONS: NONE PRICEABLE — discharge_confirmed is no, free_time_start cannot be trusted, days_left cannot be calculated
RISK: ESCALATE
STATUS: REFUSED-ESCALATE
RECOMMENDATION: REFUSED — warehouse_policy.md WP-6 and carrier_contracts.md CC-4: free_time_start is recorded as 2026-07-22 but discharge_confirmed is no, so the clock has not started and days_left cannot be trusted. Additionally, no yard slot is assigned. Two possible readings exist: discharge happened and was not logged, making the container 2 days from expiry with no slot, or discharge is genuinely delayed and the clock has not started at all. Terminal confirmation is required to choose between them.
RATIONALE: The container shows free_time_start 2026-07-22 with 2 days remaining until expiry 2026-08-05, but discharge_confirmed is no and yard_slot is blank. These fields directly contradict each other. No cost figure may be produced when the fundamental question — whether the free-time clock has started — cannot be answered from the data.
WHY: free_time_start, discharge_confirmed, yard_slot, days_left; CC-4, WP-6
SOURCES: P-2055, CC-4, WP-6
RETURN DAY: NONE
ESCALATION: Conflicting data — free_time_start recorded as 2026-07-22 but discharge_confirmed is no, indicating under CC-4 that the clock has not started and any derived days_left figure is unreliable. Additionally no yard slot has been assigned despite the container showing as awaiting_discharge. Terminal confirmation is required to establish whether discharge has occurred and the clock is running, or whether discharge is genuinely delayed and the recorded free_time_start must be disregarded.

EV-05.name: Boundary refusal - carrier swaps booked 40HDRY for a non-contracted NOR

raw.text:
WAREHOUSE SUMMARY: WH-BCN, 84% occupancy (at-risk band), 1 container reviewed, 0 at risk, 1 escalated, 0 EUR total exposure

---

CONTAINER: P-2066
CARRIER: Poseidón Freight
CONTAINER TYPE: 40NOR
DAYS LEFT: UNKNOWN
COUNTS: NONE APPLY
OPTIONS: NONE PRICEABLE — unit type 40NOR is not one of 20DRY, 40DRY, 40HDRY, so no free-time period and no D&D rate exist
RISK: ESCALATE
STATUS: REFUSED-ESCALATE
RECOMMENDATION: REFUSED — carrier_contracts.md CC-1 and CC-5: container P-2066 carries unit type 40NOR, which is not listed among the three covered dry cargo types (20DRY, 40DRY, 40HDRY). A contracted carrier supplying an uncovered unit type does not make that unit type contractual. Falla & Co. has no agreed free-time period and no agreed D&D rate for this container.
RATIONALE: Poseidón Freight substituted a Non-Operating Reefer for the booked 40HDRY unit. The unit type 40NOR falls outside the scope defined in CC-1, which covers dry cargo only. No cost calculation or return recommendation may be produced.
WHY: container_type, carrier; CC-1, CC-5, WP-6
SOURCES: P-2066, CC-1, CC-5, WP-6
RETURN DAY: NONE
ESCALATION: No matching policy — unit type 40NOR is not one of 20DRY, 40DRY, 40HDRY. The carrier Poseidón Freight is under contract, but the contract covers dry cargo unit types only. A contracted carrier does not make an uncovered unit type contractual. Evidence: container_type recorded as 40NOR; CC-1 lists only 20DRY, 40DRY, 40HDRY as covered; notes field states the unit was substituted for a booked 40HDRY.
